faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Pembroke Welsh Corgi?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 24-30 lb (11-14 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Pembroke Welsh Corgi?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Intervertebral disc disease (IVDD); Degenerative myelopathy risk; Obesity. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Pembroke Welsh Corgi at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Pembroke Welsh Corgi, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
